Stack Rasters by Depth/Level into Multidimensional VRT

Source: R/convenience.R
vrt_depth_stack.Rd

A convenience wrapper for gdal_mdim_stack() for vertical profile data (soil layers, atmospheric levels, ocean depths, etc.)

Usage

vrt_depth_stack(
  files,
  values,
  direction = "DOWN",
  unit = NULL,
  dim_name = NULL,
  array_name = NULL,
  output = NULL
)

Arguments

files

Character vector of file paths

values

Numeric vector of depth/level values, or regex pattern to extract

direction

Vertical direction: "DOWN" (depth increases), "UP" (elevation). Default: "DOWN"

unit

Unit string (e.g., "m", "cm", "hPa")

dim_name

Dimension name. Default: "depth" if direction is DOWN, "level" if UP.

array_name

Name for the data array

output

Output VRT path

Value

Path to VRT file (invisibly), or XML string if output is NULL.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Soil layers at specific depths
vrt_depth_stack(
  files = c("soil_0cm.tif", "soil_30cm.tif", "soil_100cm.tif"),
  values = c(0, 30, 100),
  unit = "cm",
  output = "soil_profile.vrt"
)

# Extract depth from filename
vrt_depth_stack(
  files = list.files(pattern = "temp_\\d+m\\.tif$"),
  values = "(\\d+)m",  # extracts "50" from "temp_50m.tif"
  unit = "m",
  output = "ocean_profile.vrt"
)
} # }
